newsitem.title: USA: Faulding unit gets FDA approval for valve.
newsitem.headline: Faulding unit gets FDA approval for valve.

text.p: Faulding Inc's said on Monday its Faulding Medical Device Co subsidiary received U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval to manufacture and market its patented Safe-Connect Valve.
The valve is a type of intravenous connector that does not require a needle, the company said.
The market for such products was estimated at $25-$40 million, Faulding said, adding that first sales were expected early in 1997.

Faulding President and Chief Executive Officer Richard Moldin said its valve allowed fluid to flow in both directions once a syringe without a needle or other intravenous device was attached. There was no detrimental back-flow upon removal of the device, the company said.
